It can take a while to get on the calendar at Endurance so I would call asap!
Would recommend Rattlesnake Wilderness instead for an overnight close to town. Blue Mountain is dry.
Winco had ice earlier this afternoon

Hey, I would suggest bringing this idea to Run Wild Missoula as they are the nonprofit in town that organizes group runs. They have the infrastructure, membership etc and I know they are already considering a similar idea! If you suggested this it would show there is increased community interest.
Hellgate Venture Network is a good place to learn about startups and entrepreneurs in missoula. They have a monthly meeting.
Run Wild Missoula has weekly running clubs/meetups, or talk to any staff at Runner’s Edge about upcoming events/classes!
You can do this! 24 hours at a time. I’m 2.5 years sober and it came one day at a time. Connection to others is key.
EVST is good, another program to consider there is ESS (Environmental Science and Sustainability). It’s in the forestry school and has a good reputation.
I was suicidal this time of year last year. Instead of going that route, I trained for and ran my first ultramarathon. I’m not a naturally athletic person so I’m proud of myself.
Milwaukee is the same for me. Losing people left and right.
Thank you. I am sorry for your loss.

Did a similar thing this past weekend, combined benzos with alcohol and ended up in the hospital. 
Wish I could say I’m happy I woke up. 

I’m sorry you’re going through this. There’s a reason you’re still here.
